what: Kev-0.8B: every graph form measured on the way to the release, per device. A form is the Gated DeltaNet recurrence's form inside a call (unrolled steps, an in-graph chunk scan, or the overlay's fp32 Metal chunk kernel) and the call's query length (a static S, or a dynamic length with the host's call plan). Each form keeps its gate summary against the author's fp32 oracle, its times with the window they were measured in, and the process memory footprint where it was recorded. Times from different windows are not comparable. Compare forms only inside one window. The lane files named in `sources` hold every value.

bar.argmax: equal to the author's fp32 oracle on every question whose oracle top-2 margin is above 0.02 (near-ties listed apart)

windows.r2 shared GPU: round 2 (2026-10-03), the Python readout gate on a GPU shared with other lanes. ms per call is the warm median of the gate's own calls. These are contended reference values.
windows.r7 lock window: round 7, 2026-10-04 00:11:55-00:33:49 JST, the machine-wide GPU lock, no other GPU job, Swift Release CLI on the AOT asset, two processes x 10 decisions (median)
windows.r11 screen: round 11, 2026-10-04 08:48:47-09:08:27 JST, one lock window shared with the lane's own exports (contended): the s80 subset (130 rows), warm median ms per call
windows.r11 lock window: round 11, 2026-10-04 09:43:31-10:45:20 JST, three lock windows, Swift Release CLI, AOT; only clean processes (no other GPU job during the process, 1-minute load average <= 12 at its start and end), up to two per form, 10 decisions each after one warm-up
windows.r14 lock window: round 14, 2026-10-04 11:24:06-11:53 JST, Python reference host (decide.py engine), AOT, clean processes as in round 11
windows.r14 shared GPU: round 14 window 2 (10:46:40-10:52:15 JST), the Python readout gate's warm median ms per call
windows.r15 lock window: round 15, 2026-10-04 12:13:21-12:27:56 JST, Swift Release CLI, two clean processes per form, 10 decisions each after one warm-up; the Python host's two items in the same window
windows.r8 device bench: round 8, 2026-10-04 00:4x JST, iPhone 18 Pro, KevGate (Swift host, Release), 60 s of rest before each item, one warm-up, then 5 decisions (median), thermal state nominal at each start, on USB power
windows.r13 device bench: round 13 stage A, 2026-10-04 10:29-11:29 JST, iPhone 18 Pro, KevGate, U16 then K64, K128, K32, K16 then U16 in one session, the round 8 bench protocol (median of 5 decisions per item, nominal at each start, USB power)
windows.r13 device bench, stage C: round 13 stage C, 2026-10-04 11:56-12:42 JST, iPhone 18 Pro, KevGate built on round 15's host: U16, then the dynamic graph read with host calls of at most 128, 256 and 512 ids (q 16), then K128, one launch each, the round 8 bench protocol. A prepared item times the questions after one prepare.
